text.description_html:
RK International BP-7824, Leaf and Berries Cabinet Pull Rose

The Decorative Leaf Pull Backplate has an undeniable grandeur. The leaf and berry design along this rose's outer edge is sure to add an extra layer of beauty when using the matching Decorative Leaf Bow Pull. This cabinet rosette can also be used with almost any of RK International's Cabinet Pulls that have 3 inch center to centers. The elongated diamond shape freshens up this classic design and brings it into the modern age. It is available in 6 finishes including satin nickel and oil rubbed bronze.

Also Available Matching: Decorative Leaf Cabinet Knob

Specifications and Features of the RK International BP-7824 Decorative Leaf Edge Pull Backplates:

  • Material: Brass
  • Overall Length: 5"
  • Width: 1-1/4"
  • Mounting Holes Length: 3" c.c. (center to center)
  • Projection: 1-1/4"

Sold Individually
